system.description:
Proximity is an explosive ammunition that identifies the target when fired via smartlink. If the round determines that it will miss the target, it will still explode if it reaches the close proximity of the target. If the attack misses with an MoF of 10 or less, the round explodes 1d10 meters away from the target and inflicts 1d10 area effect damage (see Blast Effect, p. 193) in the proximity of the target.

Source: Eclipse Phase Core Rulebook, p. 338.
